$comment: GET /v1.0/users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/{meetingId}/transcripts -- verified against Microsoft Learn's onlinemeeting-list-transcripts reference 2026-09-16. Only meetings backed by a calendar event get a transcript through this API (Microsoft's own note: a bare onlineMeetings-created meeting with no calendar event does not). UNLIKE Google Meet's transcript_entry_list, Graph does NOT expose the spoken-word text as structured JSON here -- transcriptContentUrl is a separate download (VTT captions), fetched directly rather than through this connector, the same way Resend never carries an attachment's bytes.
title: List transcripts
description: List a finished meeting's transcripts and their download URLs.

config.label: User ID
config.description: The meeting organizer's Microsoft Entra object id.

outputShape.description: Usually one. Each has id, meetingId, createdDateTime, endDateTime, and transcriptContentUrl -- a Graph URL that answers with the VTT caption file (text/vtt), not JSON. Download it with the same access token; this connector does not fetch it for you.
